source: Ukiryu::Cli.start(['help', VERB]) and (['help']) at THOR_COLUMNS=WIDTH, captured from ukiryu/ukiryu ab6df35 on Thor 1.5.0 with $0 = 'ukiryu'

command_help.run-file:
Usage:
  ukiryu run-file REQUEST_FILE

Options:
  -r, [--register=REGISTER]                          # Path to tool register
  -o, [--output=OUTPUT]                              # Output file for response (default: stdout)
  -f, [--format=FORMAT]                              # Response format (yaml, json, table, raw)
                                                     # Default: yaml
  -d, [--dry-run], [--no-dry-run], [--skip-dry-run]  # Show execution request without executing
                                                     # Default: false
      [--shell=SHELL]                                # Shell to use for command execution (bash, zsh, fish, sh, powershell, cmd)

Execute a Ukiryu Structured Execution Request from a YAML file
command_help.exec:
Usage:
  ukiryu exec TOOL [COMMAND] [KEY=VALUE ...]

Options:
  -r, [--register=REGISTER]                          # Path to tool register
  -d, [--definition=DEFINITION]                      # Path to tool definition file
  -f, [--format=FORMAT]                              # Response format (yaml, json, table, raw)
                                                     # Default: yaml
  -o, [--output=OUTPUT]                              # Output file for response (default: stdout)
  -D, [--dry-run], [--no-dry-run], [--skip-dry-run]  # Show execution request without executing
                                                     # Default: false
  -s, [--shell=SHELL]                                # Shell to use for command execution (bash, zsh, fish, sh, powershell, cmd)
      [--stdin], [--no-stdin], [--skip-stdin]        # Read input from stdin (pass to command)
                                                     # Default: false
      [--raw], [--no-raw], [--skip-raw]              # Output raw stdout/stderr (for pipe composition)
                                                     # Default: false

Execute a tool command inline
command_help.list:
Usage:
  ukiryu list

Options:
  -r, [--register=REGISTER]  # Path to tool register

List all available tools in the register
command_help.info:
Usage:
  ukiryu info [TOOL]

Options:
  -r, [--register=REGISTER]              # Path to tool register
      [--all], [--no-all], [--skip-all]  # Show all implementations for interfaces
                                         # Default: false

Show detailed information about a tool
command_help.commands:
Usage:
  ukiryu commands TOOL

Options:
  -r, [--register=REGISTER]  # Path to tool register

List all commands available for a tool
command_help.opts:
Usage:
  ukiryu opts TOOL [COMMAND]

Options:
  -r, [--register=REGISTER]  # Path to tool register

Show options for a tool or specific command
command_help.describe:
Usage:
  ukiryu describe TOOL [COMMAND]

Options:
  -r, [--register=REGISTER]  # Path to tool register
  -f, [--format=FORMAT]      # Output format (text, yaml, json)
                             # Default: text

Show comprehensive documentation for a tool or specific command
command_help.system:
Usage:
  ukiryu system [SUBCOMMAND]

Options:
  -r, [--register=REGISTER]  # Path to tool register

Show system information (shells, etc.)
command_help.version:
Usage:
  ukiryu version

Show Ukiryu version
command_help.which:
Usage:
  ukiryu which IDENTIFIER

Options:
  -r, [--register=REGISTER]  # Path to tool register
      [--platform=PLATFORM]  # Platform to check (macos, linux, windows)
      [--shell=SHELL]        # Shell to check (bash, zsh, fish, sh, powershell, cmd)

Show which tool implementation would be selected
command_help.config:
Usage:
  ukiryu config [ACTION] [KEY] [VALUE]

Options:
  -r, [--register=REGISTER]  # Path to tool register

Manage configuration (list, get, set, unset)
command_help.extract:
Usage:
  ukiryu extract TOOL

Options:
  -o, [--output=OUTPUT]                              # Output file for extracted definition
  -m, [--method=METHOD]                              # Extraction method (auto, native, help)
                                                     # Default: auto
  -v, [--verbose], [--no-verbose], [--skip-verbose]  # Enable verbose output
                                                     # Default: false

Extract tool definition from an installed CLI tool
command_help.resolve:
Usage:
  ukiryu resolve TOOL [VERSION]

Resolve which definition would be used for a tool
command_help.register:
Usage:
  ukiryu register [SUBCOMMAND]

Options:
  -f, [--force]                                      # Force re-clone the register
                                                     # Default: false
  -v, [--verbose], [--no-verbose], [--skip-verbose]  # Show verbose output
                                                     # Default: false

Manage the tool register
